# namesilo_auto_renew (Resource)

Manages one domain's auto-renew — NameSilo's flag that renews the domain at expiry and charges the account for the renewal.

`enabled` is the desired state, so resource existence does not imply auto-renew is on: `enabled = false` keeps this resource and declares that the domain must be left to expire, rather than deleting the resource to turn renewal off. Destroy stops automatic renewal only when the state says it was on — removing the resource stops renewal, and a domain left to expire can be lost entirely. This is the most consequential destroy in this provider: the others cost an outage or a missing safety net, this one can lose the domain.

Auto-renew is not offered by every TLD, and a renewal charges the account when it fires; when NameSilo rejects the toggle for that reason, the API error is surfaced unchanged, so the registry's own message is what you see. Drift detection is the normal refresh: a change made in the web UI is picked up on the next plan and corrected.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "namesilo_auto_renew" "example" {
  domain  = "example.com"
  enabled = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) The domain whose auto-renew flag to manage, e.g. `example.com`. Changing it forces a replacement: the resource is pointed at a different domain rather than renamed. Also the import ID.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether NameSilo should automatically renew the domain at expiry and charge the account for the renewal. This is the desired state, not a claim about the current one: `enabled = false` keeps the resource and declares the domain must be left to expire. Auto-renew is not offered by every TLD, and NameSilo's error for those is surfaced unchanged.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The domain name. It is inert (Terraform keys state by resource address), it makes `tofu state show` readable, and it is the import ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The import ID is the domain name. Import seeds domain and id, then the
# refresh that follows reads the auto-renew flag from the API.
tofu import namesilo_auto_renew.example example.com
```
